text: Determinism (in biology). The doctrine that all organic phenomena have efficient causes or antecedents, in terms of which they are explicable. Biological determinism asserts that, no matter what psychological phenomena may or may not accompany organic changes, these changes in themselves are determined by antecedent vital changes. See EVOLUTION (cosmic). ( C.LL.M. - J.M.B. )
